TYPE 1 ZONING MAP AMENDMENT!
NARRATIVE

The property is located at 6151-6159 S. University Avenue and 1144-1160 E. 62nd Street. The /ot is 17,411
square feet, The property measures 100 feet along the. S. University Avenue frontage and 174.10 feet along
the 62"d Street frontage. Currently, the property is improved with a concrete sports court.

(a) Floor Area Ratio. Pursuant to Section 17-2-0304-A, the maximum FAR in the RM6 district is 4.40.
The proposed project's FAR is 2.99 (ie, 52,180 SF building area 17,411 SF lot area= 2.99). Therefore, the
project conforms to the FAR standards.

(b) Density (lot area per dwelling unit). Pursuant to Section 17-2-0301-A, the minimum Jot area in
the RM6G district is 1,650 square feet. The subject property's Jot area is 17,411 square feet. Therefore, the
project conforms to the minimum /of area.

Pursuant to Section 17-2-0303-A, the minimum Jot area per unit in the RM6 district is 300 feet per
Dwelling Unit. The proposed project will be comprised of 46 Dwelling Units. Therefore, the minimum /ot
area per unit is 13,800 square feet. The subject property's /ot area is 17,411 square feet. Therefore, the
project conforms to the minimum /ot area per unit standards.

(c) Off-Street Parking. Based on the proposed Elderly Housing use, pursuant to Section 17-10-
0207-A, the minimum vehicle parking requirement is 1 space per unit resulting in a minimum parking
requirement of 46 off-street vehicle parking spaces (i.e., | space x 46 units = 46 vehicle parking spaces).
The project proposes 4 off-street accessible spaces. Therefore, the project does not conform to the
minimum vehicle parking, requirements. However, pursuant to Section 17-10-0102-B-(a), in all
districts except D districts, minimum off-street automobile parking ratios may be reduced by up to 100
percent from the otherwise applicable standards for new construction or rehabilitation or reuse of
existing structures located within 2,640 feet of a CTA rail station entrance or exit or within 1,320 feet of
aCTA bus line corridor roadway segment listed in Table 17-17-0400-B. The subject property is located
approximately 2,394.55 feet from the 63rd Street/Cottage. Grove Ave. Green Line. CTA Station and
will be new construction. Therefore, the project conforms with the minimum parking requirement as
modified by Section 17-10-0102-B-(a).

The plans prepared by Barry Architect dated December 11, 2025, show that the off-street parking
area conforms with Section 17-10-1000.

Because the proposed use is Elderly Housing, there is no minimum off-street loading ratio
under Section 17-10-1101.

(d) Front Setback. Pursuant to Section 17-2-0305-C, the minimum required front setback is 15 feet.
The proposed building front setback is 0 feet. Therefore, the project does not conform to the minimum front

Rear Setback. Pursuant to Section 17-2-0306-C, the minimum required rear setback is 50 feet.
The proposed rear setback is 34'-3".. Therefore, the project does not conform to the minimum rear
setback standard. However, in connection with the application for a zoning map amendment, the
applicant is secking a variation from this setback requirement pursuant to Section 17-13-1101-B.

| Side Setback. Pursuant to Section 17-2-0309-A, because one of the site lot lines abuts 62nd
Street, no side setback is required along this frontage. The proposed side setback along the street
frontage is 0 feet. Also, pursuant to this section, the side setback along the north property line must be at
least 10% of the lot's width which results in a minimum requirement of 10 feet (i.c., 10% x 100 feet lot
width= 10). The proposed north property line side setback is 8 feet. Therefore, the project does not
conform to the minimum setback standard. However, in connection with the application for a zoning
map amendment, the Applicant is seeking a variation from this setback requirement pursuant to Section
17-13-1101-B.

(e) Building Height. Pursuant to Section 17-2-0311-A, there is no maximum building height
restriction for principal residential buildings. The proposed building height is 66 feet. Therefore, the
project conforms to the building height standards.
